description: This file defines the OAuthRefreshToken entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing an OAuth 2.0 refresh token with properties such as token strings, expiry time, and revoke status. It uses Doctrine ORM mappings for persistence.

classes.name: OAuthRefreshToken
classes.description: Entity class representing an OAuth2 refresh token with methods to get and set token details, expiry time, and revoke status.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the refresh token.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the refresh token.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Returns the access token string associated with this refresh token.

methods.name: getExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Returns the expiry date and time in UTC as a DateTimeImmutable object.

methods.name: setExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Sets the expiry date and time.

methods.name: isRevoked
methods.description: Returns whether the token has been revoked.

methods.name: setRevoked
methods.description: Sets the revoked status of the token.
